children: Partnership reinforces Lightspeed's commitment to supporting golf clubs and associations in its home province of Quebec
MONTREAL, Sept. 9, 2026 /CNW/ --

) ("Lightspeed" or the "Company"), the unified omnichannel platform powering ambitious retail, golf and hospitality businesses in over 100 countries, today announced a new partnership with the Association des Clubs de Golf du Québec (ACGQ), naming Lightspeed the association's Official Golf Management Software Partner.

The partnership marks a dedicated investment in Quebec's golf community from Lightspeed, a company deeply rooted in Montréal. Founded, and headquartered in Quebec, Lightspeed is committed to supporting the clubs and associations that help strengthen the sport across the province. Through its partnership with the ACGQ, Lightspeed will work more closely with Quebec golf leaders and provide member clubs with access to technology, expertise and resources designed to help them run their businesses more efficiently and deliver better experiences for golfers.

"Quebec is home for Lightspeed, and our commitment to this market is reflected in the way we support the businesses and communities that make the province special," said Fraser Marriott, Head of Golf at Lightspeed. "Our partnership with the ACGQ is an opportunity to work alongside a trusted association and help Quebec golf clubs build stronger, more connected operations for the future."

"The ACGQ is pleased to announce this new partnership with a locally headquartered company whose technologies are tailored to the realities of our golf industry," said Stéphane Dubé, Executive Director of the ACGQ. "Lightspeed has extensive experience in the golf industry and has developed partnerships capable of supporting all clubs in Quebec—from private to semi-private and public clubs, as well as our indoor golf centers. ACGQ members will be able to rely on Lightspeed's support and the extensive experience it has built up over more than 20 years. Lightspeed is used by more than 2,000 golf courses and has developed unparalleled expertise in the golf industry."

As part of the partnership, Lightspeed and the ACGQ will work together to support Quebec's golf community and strengthen connections among the association, its member clubs and Lightspeed's golf customers. Through this collaboration, the partners will share resources, foster engagement and help golf businesses thrive. Lightspeed will have opportunities to connect with club leaders and demonstrate its solutions at select ACGQ events, allowing Lightspeed's golf team to connect directly with Quebec's club leaders.

The partnership builds on Lightspeed's broader commitment to helping golf businesses manage their operations through a connected platform spanning tee sheets, point of sale, payments, retail, food and beverage, memberships and reporting. With local roots and a global perspective, Lightspeed helps golf businesses simplify day-to-day operations, improve customer experiences and grow with confidence.

About Lightspeed

Lightspeed is the POS and payments platform powering businesses at the heart of communities in over 100 countries. As the partner of choice for ambitious retail, golf and hospitality entrepreneurs, Lightspeed helps businesses accelerate growth, deliver exceptional customer experiences, and run smarter across all channels and locations.

With fast, flexible omnichannel technology, Lightspeed brings together point of sale, ecommerce, embedded payments, inventory, reporting, staff and supplier management, financial services, and an exclusive wholesale retail network. Backed by insights, and expert support, Lightspeed helps businesses run more efficiently and focus on what they do best.
Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange and Toronto Stock Exchange (
), with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific.

About the Quebec Golf Clubs Association

The Quebec Golf Club Association, Inc. is dedicated to promoting the profession of golf club general managers by providing its members with training and professional development resources tailored to their needs, representing its members before various governing bodies, and fostering the mutual assistance and support characteristic of any professional association.  www.acgq.ca
